phases.description: Find the selected Openlands artifact, read its descriptor, verify official identity, and accept the active runtime target.
Load Echo-owned JSON contracts from common data paths before any runtime-specific objects are registered.
Register blocks, items, recipes, tags, loot tables, and station surfaces from Echo IDs.
Bind starter biomes, landmark pools, creature spawns, ambience, and first-hour spawn guarantees.
Bind first-hour progression, save/load fields, shelter scoring, waystones, HoloMap, co-op state, builder UX, homestead, and sounds.
Expose Openlands as playable only after smoke checks and relaxed Standard-mode checks pass.
Promote only after local validation, published artifacts, launcher flows, runtime parity, playtest evidence, waystone reload evidence, and legal review.

loadSteps.summary: Read META-INF/echo.mod.json, verify id echoopenlandsprotocol, version 0.1.0, official pack_root role, and active runtime target.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Do not load any registry data when descriptor identity or runtime target is wrong.

loadSteps.summary: Load relaxed Standard config, Hardlands overlay policy, and original-content policy before exposing pack UI.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Start in disabled-pack state instead of accidentally enabling harsh survival rules.

loadSteps.summary: Parse block, item, recipe, loot, tag, and conformance payloads before runtime-specific object creation.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Stop before partial block, item, or recipe registration can reach a save.

loadSteps.summary: Parse biomes, landmarks, creatures, waystones, first-hour route, production phase matrix, playtest fixtures, tutorials, index gameplay catalog, HoloMap, sounds, runtime execution acceptance, and all system contracts.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Keep world creation disabled until all required world and system payloads parse.

loadSteps.summary: Register MVP blocks, items, canonical tags, block drops, creature drops, and structure loot using Echo IDs.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Fail adapter startup for missing content ids rather than silently substituting unrelated content.

loadSteps.summary: Bind echostationcore:handcrafting, echostationcore:field_bench, echostationcore:kiln, echostationcore:forge_hearth, echostationcore:cookpot, map-table, echostationcore:loom, and mason-table recipe surfaces.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Keep station UI closed when assigned recipes cannot be registered.

loadSteps.summary: Bind starter biomes, landmarks, creature spawns, ambience, and guaranteed first-hour resources.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Reject invalid starter seeds or disable world creation until spawn guarantees pass.

loadSteps.summary: Bind discovery prompts, shared runtime-core shelter scoring, sleeping milestone, echoworldstarter:bedroll spawn, echoworldstarter:campfire state, inventory, hotbar, chests, route save fields, and playtest checkpoints.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Block Public Alpha if a fresh save cannot complete and reload the first-hour loop.

loadSteps.summary: Bind shared runtime-core waystone repair progression, HoloMap reveal data, old road segments, contributors, ownership, and public-travel permissions.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Disable fast travel and keep release state at warning until persistence passes.

loadSteps.summary: Bind relaxed homestead systems, builder UX commands, and Openlands sound events without enabling hardcore Standard rules.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Disable affected alpha surfaces rather than corrupting inventory, saves, or legal asset policy.

loadSteps.summary: Expose adapter-ready metadata after smoke checks prove Standard starts, interaction works, and hardcore meters are off.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Keep the pack disabled in the runtime menu until smoke checks pass.

loadSteps.summary: Promote only after contract validation, uploaded artifacts, launcher flows, parity playtests, waystone reload, and legal audit pass.
loadSteps.failurePolicy: Release Index must stay warning and launcher must not offer public install.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Descriptor file is parsed from the selected artifact before registry data is read.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Stop loading and report the missing or unreadable descriptor.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Module id, version, official flag, role, kind, and pack id match the Openlands contract.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Reject the artifact as the wrong module or wrong version.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Active runtime is echo_native, echo_runtime_standalone, or neoforge and is declared by descriptor and contract.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Reject the artifact for this runtime family.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Common data root and asset root resolve with Echo-owned paths.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Stop before registration and report the missing root.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: openlands_standard has gentle hunger, no stamina, no hydration, no spoilage, no temperature damage, and recoverable death pack.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Refuse to start a Standard world with harder default rules.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Only openlands_hardlands enables harsher survival systems.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable invalid overlays until config is repaired.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Original names, assets, recipes, silhouettes, and branding policy is loaded before public UI text is exposed.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Block release promotion until legal/content review passes.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: All required registry and system JSON files parse with schema fields intact.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Stop loading and report malformed resources.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Core payloads declare echo_native, echo_runtime_standalone, and neoforge parity.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep release index state at warning until parity declarations are repaired.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: MVP counts meet at least 50 blocks, 45 items, 35 recipes, 4 biomes, 10 creatures, and required system contracts.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Do not ship Public Alpha.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Every recipe, loot, tag, biome, spawn, structure, sound, and system reference resolves.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Stop before partial registries reach a save.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Every block in the conformance fixture resolves in the runtime registry.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail adapter startup for missing block registrations.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Every item in the conformance fixture resolves in the runtime registry.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail adapter startup for missing item registrations.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Every recipe resolves against the correct station id.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep affected crafting screens closed.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Block and item tags resolve only to known Openlands ids.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Stop registration and report invalid tag membership.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Runtime ids map back to Echo ids without replacing the source of truth.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Reject generated runtime output until id mapping is corrected.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Block, creature, and structure drops resolve without null entries.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable affected loot and fail parity validation.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Each station exposes only recipes assigned to its station id.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail station smoke checks.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Starter biome palettes use only registered Openlands blocks.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable Openlands world creation until repaired.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Creature spawns reference registered creatures and valid biomes.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Suppress invalid spawns and fail parity validation.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Landmarks resolve all block palettes and include HoloMap/tutorial hooks.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable invalid landmarks and keep release at warning.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Starter area includes trees, loose stones, fiber, berries, water, and one cave, road, or ruin hint.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Reject the seed or regenerate the starter area.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Discovery prompts fire once for starter resources, first tools, echoworldstarter:campfire, shelter, route, and waystone events.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail first-hour playtest evidence.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Shelter score accepts roof, walls, door, echoworldstarter:bedroll, light/fire, and hostile distance with a forgiving threshold.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail first-hour milestone.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Inventory, hotbar, placed blocks, chests, echoworldstarter:bedroll, echoworldstarter:campfire, shelter, waystone, and HoloMap fields survive reload.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Block Public Alpha.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Waystone state persists from undiscovered to active, including contributors, route ids, names, and permissions.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable fast travel and fail waystone parity tests.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Restored waystones reveal region data, hints, old roads, and player markers after reload.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail map reveal promotion.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Owner, group, public, contributor, rename, and public-travel permissions persist for shared state.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable public travel and co-op promotion.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Crops, compost, watering, echostationcore:cookpot meals, animal pens, and trader surplus bind without Standard-mode spoilage or death-by-neglect.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep homestead alpha disabled.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Hammer cycling, scaffold, quick stack, quick deposit, sorting, named chests, and craft-from-storage do not desync inventory.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable affected builder command and fail UX parity tests.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Creature, ambience, block, station, waystone, and UI sound keys resolve in assets/echoopenlandsprotocol/sounds.json.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Mute missing events and fail asset validation.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Missing textures, models, blockstates, and sounds use explicit placeholder policy, never borrowed assets.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Fail legal/content audit.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Ready signal includes module id, pack id, version, runtime target, and load step ids.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep runtime at disabled-pack state.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Fresh Openlands Standard world reaches first interactive frame and supports spawn, hotbar, inventory, block place/break, and menu exit.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Block release promotion.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Fresh and loaded Standard worlds do not expose stamina, hydration, spoilage, or temperature damage.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Reject Standard config load.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: validate-openlands-contract.mjs exits with no errors and required artifacts exist.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Do not promote Release Index entries beyond warning.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Native, Standalone, NeoForge, and sources artifacts are uploaded and indexed with matching sha256 values.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep pack manifests disabled for public download.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Launcher validates install, update, repair, rollback, hash checks, config preservation, and save preservation.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Keep launcher channel state at warning.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Each runtime proves spawn, gather, craft, shelter, sleep, explore, restore waystone, reveal map, save, and reload.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Do not ship Public Alpha.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: Waystone route binding, HoloMap reveal, contributors, two-stone travel unlock, and permissions survive reload.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Disable fast travel and block release.

runtimeEvidenceRequirements.successCriteria: No Minecraft names, copied assets, copied silhouettes, copied recipe identity, or Minecraft branding ships.
runtimeEvidenceRequirements.failureAction: Block public release until issues are removed.

echo_native: Load common JSON directly through Echo content contracts.
Call OpenlandsFirstHourRuntime hooks for Standard rules, starter spawn validation, shelter scoring, waystone transitions, and adapter readiness.
Register Native block, item, recipe, worldgen, save, HoloMap, and sound surfaces from Echo ids.
Return adapterBootstrapStepIds and requiredRuntimeEvidence through the Native module description.
Keep Standard mode relaxed even when optional Hardlands data is present.
echo_runtime_standalone: Load common JSON without Minecraft classes or Minecraft resource identifiers.
Call OpenlandsFirstHourRuntime hooks for Standard rules, starter spawn validation, shelter scoring, waystone transitions, and adapter readiness.
Provide standalone block, item, worldgen, inventory, shelter, waystone, HoloMap, and co-op state surfaces.
Persist FIRST_HOUR_SAVE_LOAD_FIELDS and waystone multiplayer state using Echo schema keys.
Report runtime smoke evidence from the standalone first-frame test.
neoforge: Convert Echo ids to NeoForge ResourceLocations only at adapter output time.
Call OpenlandsFirstHourRuntime hooks for Standard rules, starter spawn validation, shelter scoring, waystone transitions, and adapter readiness.
Generate runtime data from common registries while keeping Echo ids as the authoritative ids.
Use neoforge.mods.toml only as the NeoForge artifact descriptor, not as the source of common identity.
Prove no Minecraft-owned names, textures, silhouettes, or branding are introduced by generated resources.
